title: Smart compaction as a dry run: what a compacted task log would keep and lose, with the numbers

chat.text: The compaction rule from the repo-size plan becomes a Compact class that only plans: which lines a landed, quiet task log would keep verbatim (decisions, verdicts, reviews, the landing) and which would fold into counted summaries, with bytes before and after. Run dry over August and September for the numbers; a test guards the rule; nothing is applied.
